source_materials.title: Gut microbiota modulation: a novel strategy for prevention and treatment of colorectal cancer

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 作为肠道微生态干预效果的广泛证据，展示菌群重塑对微生物组其他属性（如耐药性）的深远影响。
broader_review_uses.material: RBX2660治疗导致ARGs减少，且与供体定植正相关；ARO清除率及反弹现象。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于讨论肠道菌群的整体健康状况（包括耐药负担）如何受微生态疗法影响，可能间接关联到宿主对药物（如ICI）的反应环境，但需谨慎推断因果链条。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 提供关于供体筛选和治疗安全性的背景信息。
broader_review_uses.material: 研究中检测到供体中存在ESBL大肠杆菌，但未导致患者侵袭性感染；强调了供体筛查的重要性。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于综述中关于微生态疗法安全性、标准化及潜在风险的讨论部分，提醒读者关注供体来源微生物的安全性问题。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 研究对象为CDI患者而非实体瘤患者，干预目的为感染控制而非免疫调节，需明确区分临床背景。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了微生态疗法改变肠道菌群组成的具体案例，显示成功治疗伴随菌群向健康供体状态收敛。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 可用于说明肠道菌群的可塑性及其对系统性疾病治疗的潜在全身性影响；作为菌群-疾病关联的背景证据。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 该机制针对的是抗生素耐药性，而非直接针对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）的药代动力学或免疫激活机制；未涉及T细胞或炎症因子等免疫介导路径。
facet_contributions.contribution: 揭示了供体菌群定植程度（DFD）与宿主耐药基因负荷之间的负相关机制，提示竞争性排斥可能是减少耐药性的机制之一。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 可用于探讨菌群-宿主互作中“定植抗性”（colonization resistance）的概念，解释外来菌群如何抑制潜在病原体或耐药基因的扩增。

review_planning_B.planning_summary: 该论文提供了微生物群干预（特别是FMT/RBX2660）对宿主肠道耐药组（Resistome）影响的实证数据。对于综述而言，它证明了菌群重建可以伴随耐药性的降低，并指出了“供体定植效率”是决定耐药性改善程度的关键中介变量。这有助于解释为何某些微生态疗法可能间接改善抗感染疗效或降低院内感染风险，尽管其主要适应症并非肿瘤免疫。
scope_interpretation_cautions: 该研究针对的是复发性CDI患者，其肠道菌群处于严重失调状态，与实体瘤患者基线菌群可能有显著差异，结果不可直接外推至肿瘤患者群体。
观察到的耐药性降低可能与前期使用的万古霉素治疗有关，由于缺乏无治疗对照组，无法完全归因于RBX2660本身的生物学效应。
ASV追踪反映的是基因存在与否，而非功能性耐药表型，因此“清除”一词需谨慎解读，可能仅指相对丰度低于检测限或敏感菌株的存在。

study_summary_A.approach: 采用回顾性/二次分析设计，针对PUNCH CD试验中29例提供纵向粪便样本的患者进行分析。方法包括：(1) 16S rRNA基因测序分析微生物分类学组成，使用加权UniFrac距离衡量患者与供体菌群的相似性（DFD）；(2) 全宏基因组鸟枪法测序分析功能通路和ARGs含量，使用ShortBRED预测ARGs；(3) 选择性培养基培养分离多重耐药生物（ARO），并通过分离株基因组测序进行纵向追踪。统计模型使用广义线性混合效应模型分析ARGs与DFD的关系。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 提供了微生物群恢复疗法不仅治疗CDI，还能作为减少肠道抗生素耐药菌和耐药基因负荷的辅助机制的证据；建立了供体菌群定植程度（DFD）与耐药基因减少之间的定量关联。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 所给摘要未交代对照组（如安慰剂组或未治疗组）数据，无法排除自然病程或前期抗生素治疗本身对耐药性降低的影响；样本量较小（N=29），且主要为白人女性老年人群，外推性受限；ASV追踪不能直接区分耐药表型与敏感菌株，可能存在高估；未量化流行病学层面的传播风险。

key_findings.conditions: 成功预防CDI复发的患者（SI组）
key_findings.finding: 治疗后7天，患者菌群与供体菌群的加权UniFrac距离显著缩小，表明供体菌群成功定植；特定有益菌属（如Blautia, Roseburia）丰度增加，而变形菌门（如Escherichia, Klebsiella）丰度降低。
RBX2660 administration后2个月内，抗生素耐药肠杆菌科（Enterobacteriaceae）的丰度急剧下降；67%的被追踪ARO物种被清除，但部分物种（如Escherichia）存在后期反弹现象。

key_findings.conditions: ARGs丰度与供体定植程度的关系
key_findings.finding: 患者肠道中ARGs的总丰度随时间推移总体下降，且ARGs的携带量与DFD呈显著负相关（即供体菌群定植越好，耐药基因越少）。这种相关性在治疗来源的ARGs中最为强烈。

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: 目前缺乏有效手段减少或预防抗生素耐药细菌在肠道中的定植。虽然已知粪菌移植（FMT）可预防CDI复发，但其对非艰难梭菌多重耐药菌及整体耐药组的影响尚不明确。本研究旨在探究RBX2660治疗是否能通过恢复肠道菌群结构，抑制非CDI的多重耐药菌并降低肠道内的抗生素耐药基因丰度。
study_summary_A.research_scope: 研究对象为复发性艰难梭菌感染（CDI）患者，情境为接受微生物群恢复疗法（RBX2660，一种基于供体粪便的液态悬液治疗）后的肠道微生态变化。范围涵盖16S rRNA基因测序、全宏基因组鸟枪法测序以及选择性培养结合分离株基因组测序，时间跨度为治疗前至治疗后180天。
study_summary_A.work_summary: 本研究利用PUNCH CD临床试验中29名复发CDI患者的粪便样本，评估了微生物群恢复疗法RBX2660对肠道菌群组成、功能通路及抗生素耐药性影响。研究通过计算患者与供体菌群的距离（DFD）来量化供体菌群的定植程度，发现成功预防CDI复发的患者其菌群在7天内迅速向供体菌群收敛。同时，研究追踪了多重耐药生物（ARO）和抗生素耐药基因（ARGs）的动态变化，发现RBX2660能显著降低抗生素耐药肠杆菌科的丰度，且ARGs的减少程度与供体菌群的定植程度呈负相关。该研究证实了微生物群恢复疗法在治愈CDI的同时，具有减少宿主肠道内耐药菌和耐药基因负荷的潜在益处。

auxiliary_material: Safety observation: ESBL-producing E. coli detected in one donor product metagenomically without causing invasive infection in recipients.
Methodology for tracking antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) and multidrug-resistant organisms (AROs) longitudinally.
Limitation noted by authors: lack of placebo group to characterize natural history of ARG decrease after antibiotics.
supplement_gap_material.outline_action: Search for clinical trials specifically combining FMT with Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors (e.g., in melanoma or renal cell carcinoma). Extract donor screening protocols (inclusion/exclusion microbial features, health checks) from at least two additional ICI-FMT studies. Compare these criteria with the RBX2660 CDI trial data to assess heterogeneity. Investigate published correlations between donor microbiome features and oncology-specific outcomes (ORR, irAEs) in those trials.
supplement_gap_material.remaining_gap: This study focuses on recurrent Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI), not cancer or Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor (ICI) therapy, so it does not provide ORR or irAEs outcomes required by the success criteria. Only one trial's donor screening criteria are detailed, failing the requirement to list at least three. There is no comparison of heterogeneity across multiple trials or analysis of unified microbiome characteristic definitions in the ICI context.
useful_material: Specific donor screening criteria reported: extensive screening for MRSA, VRE, viral, bacterial, and parasitic enteric pathogens.
Quantitative engraftment metric: weighted UniFrac distance from donor (DFD) used to correlate donor microbiota convergence with treatment success.
Taxonomic features linked to efficacy: abundance of Blautia and Roseburia associated with success; Escherichia, Klebsiella, and Pluralibacter associated with treatment failure.
Dosing regimen detail: RBX2660 administered via enema, patients pre-treated with oral vancomycin.

source_materials.title: Microbiota restoration reduces antibiotic-resistant bacteria gut colonization in patients with recurrent Clostridioides difficile infection from the open-label PUNCH CD study

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: Provides a reference for how successful microbiota modulation (via FMT) alters community structure (increasing beneficials, decreasing opportunists). This structural shift can be compared to the structural shifts observed in ICI responders/resistors in the main review topic.
broader_review_uses.material: Changes in alpha diversity, Faecalibacterium enrichment, and Enterobacteriaceae depletion post-FMT in responders.
broader_review_uses.purpose: Background on microbiome dynamics during therapeutic intervention.

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: Demonstrates a methodological approach to identifying microbial predictors of therapy response. Useful for discussing the search for similar biomarkers in the ICI/solid tumor context, highlighting the challenge of finding robust, generalizable markers across different diseases.
broader_review_uses.material: Use of baseline metagenomic and qPCR data to predict clinical outcome.
broader_review_uses.purpose: Conceptual framework for 'predictive biomarkers'.

facet_contributions.boundaries: Context is Ulcerative Colitis treated with FMT, not solid tumors treated with ICIs. The direction of association (high siderophores = good response) may differ from ICI contexts where certain pathogens are often linked to resistance. Cannot directly transfer the predictive threshold (755.88 copies/ng) to cancer settings.
facet_contributions.contribution: Provides a detailed example of how specific microbial functional pathways (siderophore/iron acquisition) and taxa (E. coli) correlate with clinical response to microbiota intervention. Shows that high baseline levels of these factors predicted better outcomes in UC/FMT, suggesting a complex relationship where 'pathogenic' features might indicate a microbiome state more amenable to restoration or competition.
facet_contributions.possible_uses: Use to discuss mechanisms of microbiome-mediated therapy efficacy. Illustrate that microbial iron metabolism is a critical node in gut inflammation and host-microbe interaction. Contrast with ICI literature to explore if iron availability/metabolism plays a similar or opposing role in tumor immunity.

review_planning_B.planning_summary: This paper provides empirical evidence linking specific gut microbial functional traits (siderophore genes) and taxa (E. coli, Faecalibacterium) to the efficacy of microbiota-based interventions (FMT) in inflammatory bowel disease. While the review focuses on solid tumors and ICIs, this material offers a mechanistic parallel: how baseline microbial 'virulence' or metabolic capacity (iron acquisition) influences host response to microbiota modulation. It serves as a comparative case for mechanism F2 (how microbes mediate efficacy) in a different therapeutic context (FMT vs ICI), highlighting that microbial iron metabolism may be a conserved factor in inflammation resolution.
scope_interpretation_cautions: Study population is strictly Ulcerative Colitis patients, not cancer patients.
Intervention is FMT, not Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors.
Findings on siderophores are observational associations in a specific cohort; causality is not established.
Sample size is limited (n=70), reducing generalizability.

study_summary_A.approach: Single-center, self-controlled cohort study. 70 active UC patients (Mayo score ≥3) underwent two FMT procedures at an 8-week interval. Fecal samples were collected at baseline (F0), 8 weeks after first FMT (F1), and 8 weeks after second FMT (F2). Patients were classified into response/non-response groups based on Mayo score changes. Metagenomic sequencing was used to profile microbiota and virulence factors (VFs). Quantitative real-time PCR (qPCR) measured total bacterial siderophore gene copy numbers. Statistical analyses included ROC curves for predictive value and comparisons between groups.

contribution_and_limits.contribution: Identifies baseline total fecal siderophore gene copy number as a potential non-invasive biomarker for predicting FMT responsiveness in active UC, with high specificity.
contribution_and_limits.limits: Single-center study with a small sample size (n=70); lacks multicenter external validation; does not investigate the pathophysiological role of siderophores in UC beyond prediction.

key_findings.conditions: Active UC patients undergoing two FMTs; responders vs. non-responders.
key_findings.finding: Responders showed a significant increase in Faecalibacterium and decrease in Enterobacteriaceae post-FMT. Baseline total siderophore gene copy number was significantly higher in responders (1889.14 copies/ng) than non-responders (94.86 copies/ng). A cutoff of 755.88 copies/ng predicted responsiveness with 94.7% specificity and 72.5% sensitivity.
The iron uptake system, particularly siderophores (aerobactin), was enriched in the response group before treatment, with Escherichia coli contributing significantly to this pool.

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: Predictive markers for FMT outcomes in active UC are poorly defined. The study aims to determine if baseline gut microbiota profiles, specifically virulence factors like siderophores, can predict whether a patient will respond to FMT.
study_summary_A.research_scope: Active ulcerative colitis (UC) patients undergoing fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT); gut microbiome and siderophore gene abundance.
study_summary_A.work_summary: This study investigates the predictive value of gut microbial composition and bacterial siderophore genes for the clinical responsiveness of FMT in active UC. It is a single-center, self-controlled cohort study involving 70 patients who received two FMT sessions. The research compares responders and non-responders based on Mayo scores, analyzing pre- and post-FMT metagenomic data and quantifying total siderophore gene copy numbers via qPCR to identify biomarkers associated with treatment outcomes.

auxiliary_material.content: Recipient baseline total fecal siderophore genes copy number (cutoff 755.88 copies/ng) predicted FMT responsiveness with 94.7% specificity and 72.5% sensitivity.
auxiliary_material.relevance: While this focuses on recipient predictors rather than donor criteria, it illustrates the concept of using specific microbial functional thresholds (gene copy number) to define treatment success, which parallels the gap's inquiry about unified microbiome feature definitions.

auxiliary_material.content: Observation that responders showed increased Faecalibacterium and decreased Enterobacteriaceae post-FMT, while non-responders did not show these shifts.
auxiliary_material.relevance: Provides evidence of specific microbial taxa changes associated with clinical outcomes, useful for discussing what microbiome features might be desirable in donors or recipients.

supplement_gap_material.outline_action: Search for additional FMT clinical trial protocols (especially in oncology/ICI contexts if available, or other UC/CD trials) to extract at least 2 more donor screening criteria sets. Look for systematic reviews or meta-analyses of FMT trials that explicitly compare donor selection methods and correlate them with efficacy outcomes. Investigate literature discussing 'super-donor' concepts or specific donor microbiome profiling standards to address the unified definition criterion.
supplement_gap_material.remaining_gap: This study provides detailed screening criteria for only one single-center cohort (1 out of the required 3 trials). It does not provide donor microbiome inclusion thresholds (e.g., diversity indices or specific genus abundance for donors), focusing instead on recipient baseline predictors. It does not compare heterogeneity across multiple trials or empirically analyze how different donor screening protocols impact efficacy consistency between studies. The link between *donor* screening specifics and clinical outcomes is asserted in the background but not tested within this study's design (donors were consistent across patients).

useful_material.content: Detailed donor screening protocol including questionnaire (medical history, lifestyle, infectious pathogen exposure), serological screening (HIV, hepatitis A/B/C/E, syphilis, EBV, CMV, rotavirus), and fecal pathogen detection (E. coli O157, Salmonella, Shigella, S. aureus, Campylobacter, Yersinia, Vibrio, C. difficile toxins, parasites).
useful_material.relevance: Provides one concrete example of FMT clinical trial donor screening criteria (health and pathogen exclusion), addressing part of the success criterion to list screening standards.

useful_material.content: Statement in Background that 'Clinical response rates to FMT in UC vary across studies owing to differences in donor selection, transplantation methods, and other factors' and reference to donor microbiota composition as a factor associated with efficacy.
useful_material.relevance: Acknowledges the heterogeneity issue and the link between donor characteristics and efficacy, supporting the gap question's premise even if this study does not perform the cross-trial comparison itself.

useful_material.content: Donor exclusion criteria regarding medication use (no antibiotics, probiotics, or microbiota-affecting drugs during donation period) and re-evaluation frequency (every three months).
useful_material.relevance: Adds specific operational details to the donor screening standard (medication washout and monitoring frequency).

tool_materials.question: 是否有研究直接定量了人类肿瘤微环境（TME）或血清中特定微生物代谢物（如肌苷、短链脂肪酸）的浓度，并将其与 ICI 临床响应进行了关联分析？

fulfillment_judgment.auxiliary_material: 文中提及人体血浆中肌苷和腺苷浓度通常在低微摩尔范围，但在实体瘤的坏死、缺氧或炎症微环境中可积累至数百微摩尔。作者提到肌苷补充剂在多发性硬化症和帕金森病的临床试验中显示安全耐受，为癌症免疫治疗中的代谢调节策略提供了转化参考。
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: 继续检索针对接受 ICI 治疗的人类患者队列的临床代谢组学研究，重点关注基线血清、血浆或肿瘤组织中肌苷、短链脂肪酸等特定代谢物的定量数据。筛选明确报告了代谢物浓度与客观缓解率（ORR）、无进展生存期（PFS）或总生存期（OS）之间统计关联（如 Cox 回归、Log-rank 检验）的文献。若直接关联研究稀缺，可考虑检索将微生物组数据与代谢组数据联合分析的研究，以间接推断微生物代谢物的潜在影响。
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: 该研究未报告人类肿瘤微环境或血清中肌苷（或其他微生物代谢物）的绝对或相对浓度值，也未在人类队列中分析这些代谢物水平与 ICI 临床疗效（如 ORR, PFS, OS）的统计关联。研究主要基于体外人 T 细胞实验和体内小鼠模型，缺乏人体样本的代谢组学数据与临床响应的相关性分析。此外，研究未明确区分人体内肌苷的微生物来源与宿主来源，仅将其视为微环境中的营养物质。
fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: 该研究阐明了肌苷（inosine）作为替代碳源支持效应 T 细胞（Teff）在葡萄糖缺乏环境下生存和发挥功能的分子机制：通过嘌呤核苷磷酸化酶（PNP）水解肌苷生成核糖 -1-磷酸，进入磷酸戊糖途径（PPP）和糖酵解提供 ATP 及生物合成前体。研究提供了临床前证据，显示在肿瘤细胞无法利用肌苷的小鼠模型中，补充肌苷可增强抗 PD-L1 抗体或过继性 T 细胞疗法的抗肿瘤疗效（延长生存期、增加肿瘤浸润 T 细胞）；反之，若肿瘤细胞具备利用肌苷的能力，则因营养竞争导致该增效作用消失。此外，研究区分了肌苷与其前体腺苷的免疫调节作用，指出腺苷具有免疫抑制性而肌苷支持 T 细胞功能。

fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: 该综述引用了多项研究，指出在人类样本中检测到了特定微生物代谢物并与 ICI 疗效关联。具体包括：1) 血清犬尿氨酸/色氨酸比值升高与黑色素瘤和 RCC 患者接受纳武利尤单抗治疗的总生存期（OS）较差相关 [107]；2) 血浆色氨酸代谢物 3-羟基邻苯二甲酸水平低与非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的无进展生存期（PFS）延长显著相关 [108]。文中明确将这些归类为肠道微生物群衍生的代谢物。此外，文中提到前瞻性研究中黑色素瘤患者粪便中安卡酸（anacardic acid）水平在 ICI 响应组显著增加（62 倍，P < 0.01）[96]，但样本类型为粪便而非血清或 TME。

fulfillment_judgment.auxiliary_material: Table 1 lists 10 ongoing clinical trials (NCT03353402, NCT04758507, NCT04130763, NCT04924374, NCT04729322, NCT05032014, NCT05094167, NCT04909034, NCT04552418, NCT05083416) with various interventions (FMT, probiotics, prebiotics, dietary patterns) across cancer types (melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, gastrointestinal cancer, lung cancer, liver cancer, head and neck cancer). Outcome measures include ORR, PFS, OS, CRR, DCR, DOR, and some trials include metabolite measurements as secondary outcomes. The review notes that high-fiber diet was associated with about five times higher response rate to anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in 46 melanoma patients (Spencer et al., AACR 2019 Abstract). Safety concerns for FMT are documented including bacteremia cases and FDA warnings.
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Use this review to establish the biological plausibility and mechanistic framework for why microbial metabolites could influence ICI response (SCFA effects on immune cells, inosine-A2A receptor pathway). Cite the review when discussing metabolites of interest and their proposed mechanisms. Note that human quantitative metabolite-ICI correlation studies are needed and reference the ongoing clinical trials listed that include metabolite measurements. Search for the original studies cited (e.g., Mager et al. for inosine, Spencer et al. for diet-fiber association) to determine if any contain human metabolite quantification data. Consider searching for completed results from the listed clinical trials (NCT04552418, NCT05083416) that specifically measure metabolites. Frame the gap as requiring human studies with absolute or relative metabolite concentration values statistically correlated with ICI efficacy endpoints.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: This review does not itself report quantitative concentrations of specific microbial metabolites (inosine, SCFAs) measured in human tumor microenvironment or serum/plasma samples with statistical correlation to ICI clinical outcomes (ORR, PFS, OS). The inosine finding cited is from preclinical germ-free mouse models, not human patients. While the review mentions that some ongoing clinical trials include metabolite measurements as outcome measures, it does not present completed human metabolite quantification data with ICI response correlations. The review explicitly notes in the Outstanding Questions section that there is a need for systematic study integrating gut metabolome for comprehensive understanding, indicating this type of human quantitative metabolite-ICI correlation data remains an area requiring further investigation.
fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: This review discusses microbial metabolites relevant to the gap question, including short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs: acetate, propionate, butyrate), inosine, and bile acids. It describes mechanisms by which these metabolites can modulate anti-tumor immunity: SCFAs affect macrophage and dendritic cell function, stimulate T-regulatory cells or Th1/Th17 cells, and can translocate from gut lumen to lymph nodes and blood to shape systemic immunity. The review cites Mager et al. identifying inosine as a metabolite produced by Bifidobacterium pseudolongum that improves ICI efficacy in germ-free mice with multiple tumor types, noting the effect relies on adenosine A2A receptor expression in T lymphocytes. It also mentions that clinical trials are collecting metabolite data (e.g., NCT04552418 measuring change in microbiome composition and metabolite; NCT05083416 measuring change in gut microbiome and microbial metabolites). The review acknowledges methodological challenges including the need for standardization of metabolomic profiling and systematic integration of gut transcriptome, proteome, and metabolome.

fulfillment_judgment.auxiliary_material: 文中详细阐述了色氨酸代谢物通过激活芳香烃受体（AHR）介导免疫抑制的机制，包括促进 Treg 分化、MDSC 募集和巨噬细胞极化。这一机制路径与部分微生物代谢物（如某些吲哚衍生物）可能作用的通路存在重叠，为理解代谢物如何调节 ICI 疗效提供了宿主端的参照机制。文中还分析了临床试验失败的潜在原因，如药物穿透性、代偿机制（IDO2/TDO2 上调）及既往治疗（如 BRAF 抑制剂）对代谢通路的影响，这些混杂因素的分析逻辑可迁移至微生物代谢物与 ICI 关联的研究设计中。
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: 在综述中利用此材料构建‘宿主代谢屏障’的背景，说明除微生物组外，宿主自身的代谢状态（如色氨酸 - 犬尿氨酸轴）也是调节 ICI 疗效的关键维度。可对比宿主代谢物与微生物代谢物在作用机制上的异同（如是否共同靶向 AHR），并引用文中关于代谢物分层和监测的建议，论证未来研究微生物代谢物时也应采用类似的严格定量和分层策略（如检测血清/肿瘤浓度而非仅靠菌群丰度）。同时，需明确指出本文证据限于宿主代谢，不能直接替代微生物代谢物的证据。
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: 该材料主要关注宿主酶（IDO1/2, TDO2）催化产生的代谢物，未涉及肠道微生物直接产生的特定代谢物（如肌苷、短链脂肪酸）在人体 TME 或血清中的定量数据。因此，无法提供 gap 所要求的微生物代谢物绝对或相对浓度值及其与 ICI 疗效（ORR, PFS, OS）的直接统计关联证据。
fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: 该综述引用了多项研究，报告了在人类样本（血浆、肿瘤组织）中定量宿主来源的色氨酸代谢物（如犬尿氨酸 Kyn、色氨酸 Trp）的浓度。例如，文中提到在乳腺癌或结肠癌患者中，血液和肿瘤组织中的 Kyn 浓度与 CD8+ T 细胞上 PD-1 的表达呈正相关；在肉瘤患者中，抗 PD-1 治疗后血浆 Kyn:Trp 比率升高。此外，文中详细讨论了 IDO1 抑制剂联合 ICI 的临床试验（如 ECHO-301），并指出尽管药物降低了血浆 Kyn 水平，但未能改善 PFS，提示代谢物水平与临床终点（PFS、ORR）的关联分析在试验中曾被尝试但结果复杂。作者建议未来的患者分层应基于血浆和肿瘤中 Trp、Kyn 及其下游代谢物的浓度。

fulfillment_judgment.auxiliary_material: The text provides tables listing combination therapies targeting TME components (Table 1 and Table 2), including drugs targeting CSF-1R, CXCR4, CD47, and metabolic pathways. It outlines the cancer-immune cycle and specific evasion mechanisms in 'cold' and 'hot' tumors, explaining how metabolic hostility limits T cell infiltration and activity. The authors note that tumor-associated macrophages can remove anti-PD-1 antibodies in an FcγR-dependent manner.
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Continue searching for primary clinical cohort studies or translational research papers that specifically measure microbiome-derived metabolites (such as inosine, butyrate, other SCFAs) in human biofluids or tumor biopsies. Prioritize studies that explicitly report correlation statistics (p-values, hazard ratios) between these metabolite concentrations and ICI response metrics. Use the mechanistic background from this review to frame the importance of metabolic checkpoints when discussing potential microbial metabolite effects.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The success criteria require direct quantification of specific microbial metabolites (e.g., inosine, short-chain fatty acids) in human tumor tissue or serum/plasma and statistical correlation with ICI clinical outcomes (ORR, PFS, OS). This review does not report primary data with absolute or relative concentration values of microbial metabolites in human samples. It focuses on general cancer-derived metabolites (lactate, glucose, kynurenine) and cellular mechanisms rather than microbiome-derived metabolites. No statistical association between microbial metabolite levels and ICI efficacy is presented in this text.
fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: This study is a review that summarizes mechanisms by which tumor microenvironment (TME) metabolism affects immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) efficacy. It details how cancer cells alter metabolic processes (e.g., Warburg effect, glucose depletion, lactate accumulation, amino acid restriction like tryptophan and glutamine) to suppress T cell and NK cell function. It specifically mentions the role of enzymes like IDO producing kynurenine (a tryptophan metabolite) and arginase in creating an immunosuppressive environment. The authors describe how these metabolic checkpoints contribute to ICI resistance and list various clinical trials combining ICI with metabolic or TME-targeting agents (e.g., IDO inhibitors, VEGFR inhibitors).

auxiliary_material.evidence: 小鼠模型和体外实验显示肌苷预处理肿瘤细胞可增强其对 T 细胞杀伤的敏感性，机制为直接抑制 UBA6 酶活性。
auxiliary_material.finding: 肌苷通过抑制肿瘤细胞内 UBA6 活性增强 MHC-I 表达和抗原呈递，从而增强 T 细胞杀伤。

useful_material.evidence: 研究重新分析了 CheckMate 025 试验的代谢谱数据（n=394 接受 nivolumab 治疗），发现血浆肌苷水平较高的患者 OS 更长（高组 mOS=33 个月 vs 低组 mOS=22 个月，P < 0.01），且该关联仅在 ICI 治疗组中显著，在 everolimus 组中不显著。
useful_material.finding: 人类肾细胞癌（RCC）患者血浆中肌苷（inosine）水平与 ICI（nivolumab）治疗的总生存期（OS）存在统计关联。
useful_material.relevance: 直接回应了 gap 中关于‘人类血清中特定代谢物浓度与 ICI 临床响应关联分析’的成功标准，提供了具体的代谢物（肌苷）、样本类型（血浆）和临床终点（OS）。

useful_material.evidence: 方法部分说明将代谢物水平按中位数分为高/低组（the upper half was as a high-level group; the lower half was as a low-level group defined by the median value），并使用 Kaplan-Meier 和 Cox 比例风险模型进行分析。
useful_material.finding: 肌苷水平被作为相对浓度值（基于中位数分为高/低组）用于生存分析。
useful_material.relevance: 满足成功标准中关于‘绝对或相对浓度值’的要求，证实了定量数据的存在和使用。

useful_material.evidence: 小鼠实验中，抗生素清除肠道菌群后，ICI 疗效受损且血浆嘌呤代谢物（包括肌苷）水平下降；引言部分提及肠道菌群贡献肌苷水平。
useful_material.finding: 研究提出了肌苷可能部分源于肠道菌群失调的假设，并在小鼠模型中验证了抗生素处理会降低肌苷水平。
useful_material.relevance: 支持 gap 中关于‘微生物代谢物’的背景假设，尽管人类数据未直接溯源至特定菌种，但为代谢物的微生物来源提供了间接证据。

fulfillment_judgment.auxiliary_material: The study utilized 16S rRNA gene sequencing for microbiota and LC-MS/HPLC for metabolite quantification in fecal specimens. The authors speculated a mechanism where Lachnoclostridium (enriched in responders) might convert chenodeoxycholic acid to ursodeoxycholic acid. Limitations noted by the authors include the observational design (no causal proof), the specific population (mostly viral-related HCC, Child-Pugh A), and the lack of paired serum or tumor tissue metabolite data. The study excluded patients with recent antibiotic or probiotic use to control confounding. The discussion contrasts these findings with melanoma studies, suggesting cancer-type specificity for microbiome biomarkers.
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Cite this study to demonstrate that while fecal metabolites (specifically bile acids) show promise as biomarkers in HCC, direct evidence for serum or TME metabolites is still needed. Use the negative SCFA result in feces to justify searching for serum SCFA data. Future search strategies should prioritize terms like 'serum metabolomics', 'plasma metabolites', or 'intratumoral metabolites' combined with 'immune checkpoint inhibitor' and 'response'. Differentiate between gut-liver axis findings (this study) and systemic circulation findings in the review.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The success criteria require quantification of metabolites in human tumor microenvironment (TME) or serum/plasma. This study exclusively measured metabolites in fecal samples. Therefore, it does not provide data on systemic (serum) or intratumoral metabolite concentrations. It remains unanswered whether the fecal metabolite levels correlate with serum or TME levels, or if serum/TME metabolites independently predict ICI response. The negative finding for fecal SCFAs suggests that if SCFAs are relevant biomarkers, they might need to be measured in a different compartment (e.g., serum) or specific SCFAs not measured here might be involved.
fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: This study prospectively enrolled patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (uHCC) receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) and analyzed fecal samples for microbiota and metabolites. The authors quantified fecal bile acids (BAs) and short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs). They found that secondary bile acids (ursodeoxycholic acid, ursocholic acid, murideoxycholic acid) were significantly enriched in the feces of objective responders compared to progressive disease patients and correlated with better overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS). A validation cohort (n=33) confirmed the survival benefit associated with the microbial signature. Regarding SCFAs, the authors measured acetic, propionic, and butyric acid concentrations in feces but reported no significant differences between responders and non-responders. Non-target metabolite analysis mentioned reduced fecal inosine in responders, though this was not the primary focus. The study established a statistical association between fecal metabolite concentrations and ICI clinical outcomes (ORR, PFS, OS).

[{"question_id": "Q01", "examples": [{"attribution": "Derosa et al. (2024)", "use_in_review": "提供基于生态拓扑结构的菌群失调多维定义及量化模型（TOPOSCORE），作为当前任务中“菌群失调多维定义”的核心实证材料。", "finding": "研究提出了一种基于物种相互作用组（SIGs）的个性化菌群失调评分（TOPOSCORE）。该模型识别出两个拮抗的微生物群落：SIG1（与较差生存率相关，包含口腔来源菌和产胆汁酸厌氧菌如Enterocloster）和SIG2（与较好预后相关，主要是丁酸盐产生菌如Faecalibacterium）。通过计算SIG2与SIG1物种数量的标准化差异得出评分S。当S≤0.535时定义为SIG1+（菌群失调），S≥0.791时为SIG2+（健康/真生物状态）。对于处于中间“灰色地带”的患者，进一步根据Akkermansia muciniphila的丰度进行分层：缺乏或过度丰富（>4.799%）均被视为SIG1+（菌群失调），正常水平视为SIG2+。这揭示了菌群失调并非单一维度的多样性丧失，而是特定功能群落的崩溃或病理性扩张。", "conditions": "基于955名癌症患者（非小细胞肺癌、肾细胞癌、尿路上皮癌、结直肠癌）和5346名健康志愿者的宏基因组数据；使用MetaPhlAn 4进行物种鉴定；验证了预测准确率为69.8%。", "reference_ids": ["R200"]}, {"attribution": "Fidelle et al. (2023)", "use_in_review": "提供关键生物标志物sMAdCAM-1的具体机制解释及其作为“肠道检查点”的功能，直接回答关于sMAdCAM-1的问题。", "finding": "发现抗生素诱导的菌群失调会导致肠系膜血管地址素细胞粘附分子1（MAdCAM-1）在肠道血管中的表达下调。低水平的可溶性MAdCAM-1（sMAdCAM-1）是癌症患者肠道菌群失调的标志，并预测更差的临床结局。机制上，菌群失调导致Enterocloster属细菌增殖，改变胆汁酸代谢，进而下调MAdCAM-1。MAdCAM-1的下调使得原本被限制在肠道的α4β7+FoxP3+调节性Th17（Tr17）细胞得以迁移至外周肿瘤部位，抑制局部抗肿瘤免疫。因此，sMAdCAM-1被视为反映肠道免疫招募轴完整性的“肠道检查点”生物标志物。", "conditions": "在小鼠模型和人类患者队列中验证；涉及抗PD-1治疗背景；强调sMAdCAM-1低水平与近期抗生素使用或内在菌群失调相关。", "reference_ids": ["R4", "R153", "R154"]}, {"attribution": "本综述综合观点", "use_in_review": "阐述菌群失调的多维定义框架，整合宿主因素、代谢产物和屏障功能，为Q01提供概念性总结。", "finding": "综述指出，健康的定义应超越简单的物种存在与否，而应涵盖空间组织（屏障完整性）、稳态（周转、节律）和应激反应（韧性、修复）。菌群失调被定义为这些动态过程的破坏，表现为：1）生态韧性丧失（如对干扰的抵抗力下降）；2）特定功能群落的失衡（如丁酸盐产生菌减少，病原菌扩张）；3）代谢输出的改变（如胆汁酸谱异常、短链脂肪酸减少）；4）屏障功能障碍导致的系统性炎症（如LPS易位）。这种多维定义强调了菌群失调是一个涉及宿主-微生物互作、代谢重编程和免疫调节的系统性状态，而非单一的微生物组成变化。", "conditions": "基于WHO健康标志框架；结合多组学数据（宏基因组、代谢组、蛋白质组）；适用于癌症免疫治疗背景。", "reference_ids": []}], "explanation": "该综述提出的菌群失调多维定义不再局限于传统的α/β多样性降低或单一物种丰度变化，而是强调生态系统的功能性和结构性紊乱。具体而言，菌群失调被定义为肠道微生态在空间组织（屏障完整性）、稳态（微生物群落的韧性和恢复力）以及应激反应方面的动态平衡被打破。这种破坏可以通过多个维度来测量：

1. **生态拓扑结构**：通过TOPOSCORE等模型，将菌群失调定义为有益功能群（SIG2，如丁酸盐产生菌）的崩溃和致病/促炎群（SIG1，如Enterocloster、Clostridium）的扩张。这种定义捕捉了物种间的拮抗关系和功能冗余的丧失。

2. **关键生物标志物**：
   - **sMAdCAM-1**：作为肠道血管屏障和免疫细胞归巢的关键分子，其血清水平反映了肠道局部的免疫状态。低sMAdCAM-1标志着由菌群失调引起的肠道免疫招募轴受损，允许抑制性T细胞进入肿瘤微环境。
   - **粪便标志物**：包括钙卫蛋白（反映中性粒细胞驱动的黏膜炎症）、短链脂肪酸（SCFAs，反映发酵功能）和胆汁酸（BAs，反映代谢转化能力）。
   - **血清标志物**：包括脂多糖结合蛋白（LBP）、可溶性CD14（sCD14）反映内毒素易位，以及 zonulin 反映屏障通透性。

3. **非线性关系**：某些物种（如Akkermansia muciniphila）与预后的关系呈三叉戟状，即缺乏或过度丰富均与不良结局相关，表明菌群失调是一种复杂的、非线性的生态失衡状态。", "remaining_points": ["不同疾病类型（如黑色素瘤 vs 肺癌）中，具体的菌群失调特征是否存在显著差异？", "sMAdCAM-1在不同癌症类型中的阈值是否一致？", "TOPOSCORE在 prospective clinical trials 中的实际临床效用尚未完全确立。"]}, {"question_id": "Q02", "examples": [{"attribution": "Fidelle et al. (2023)", "use_in_review": "详细阐述胆汁酸代谢、屏障功能与T细胞迁移之间的因果机制路径，是回答Q02的核心机制证据。", "finding": "建立了从菌群失调到T细胞迁移的完整机制链条：
1. **菌群失调触发**：抗生素使用或癌症相关因素导致肠道菌群失调，特别是Enterocloster属细菌的增殖。
2. **胆汁酸代谢改变**：这些细菌改变了胆汁酸（BA）的代谢谱，产生特定的胆汁酸衍生物。
3. **屏障分子下调**：改变的胆汁酸信号传导导致回肠血管内皮细胞中MAdCAM-1（肠系膜血管地址素细胞粘附分子1）的表达下调。
4. **T细胞迁移**：MAdCAM-1是α4β7整合素（存在于肠道驻留T细胞表面）的配体。MAdCAM-1的下调破坏了正常的T细胞归巢限制，使得原本被限制在肠道黏膜的α4β7+FoxP3+调节性Th17（Tr17）细胞能够穿过血管屏障，迁移至外周肿瘤部位。
5. **免疫抑制**：这些迁移至肿瘤的Tr17细胞抑制局部抗肿瘤免疫，从而削弱抗PD-1治疗的疗效。", "conditions": "在小鼠模型和人类患者队列中验证；涉及抗PD-1治疗背景；强调Enterocloster和胆汁酸代谢的关键作用。", "reference_ids": ["R4"]}, {"attribution": "Varanasi et al. (2025)", "use_in_review": "提供肝细胞癌背景下胆汁酸代谢抑制T细胞功能的补充机制，展示胆汁酸对T细胞功能的直接抑制作用。", "finding": "在肝细胞癌中，上调的胆汁酸合成和BAAT介导的结合驱动了结合型初级胆汁酸（如TCDCA）和次级胆汁酸（如LCA）的积累。这些代谢物直接抑制抗肿瘤CD8+ T细胞的功能：TCDCA引起氧化应激，LCA诱导内质网应激。抑制BAAT可以恢复T细胞活性并使肿瘤对PD-1阻断敏感。这表明胆汁酸不仅通过屏障影响T细胞迁移，还可以作为循环代谢物直接抑制效应T细胞的功能。", "conditions": "肝细胞癌模型；涉及BAAT酶活性；关注TCDCA和LCA的具体毒性作用。", "reference_ids": ["R240"]}, {"attribution": "Yonekura et al. (2022)", "use_in_review": "提供肿瘤诱导的应激 ileopathy 导致屏障功能障碍和菌群失调的机制，补充Q02中屏障功能受损的上游原因。", "finding": "肿瘤生长通过β-肾上腺素能受体（βAR）依赖性信号通路诱导“应激回肠炎”，其特征是绒毛萎缩、上皮通透性增加和持续性Clostridium属细菌扩张（以乳酸杆菌为代价）。这种屏障功能障碍促进了菌群失调，而持续的交感神经信号传导抑制了细胞毒性T细胞功能。β-阻滞剂或万古霉素可以恢复屏障完整性，限制微生物过度生长，并减缓癌症生长。这展示了从全身应激到局部屏障破坏再到免疫抑制的路径。", "conditions": "小鼠癌症恶液质模型；涉及β-肾上腺素能受体信号；关注Clostridium属的扩张。", "reference_ids": ["R114", "R117"]}], "explanation": "关于胆汁酸代谢、屏障功能与T细胞迁移的具体机制路径，综述阐述了以下几个关键环节：

1. **胆汁酸代谢作为中介**：肠道菌群负责将初级胆汁酸转化为次级胆汁酸。菌群失调（如Enterocloster增殖）会改变这一转化过程，产生具有特定免疫调节作用的胆汁酸衍生物。这些胆汁酸可以作为信号分子作用于肠道上皮和血管内皮细胞。

2. **屏障功能的分子调控**：胆汁酸代谢的改变直接影响肠道血管屏障的关键分子。例如，特定的胆汁酸谱会导致MAdCAM-1在回肠血管内皮上的表达下调。MAdCAM-1是维持肠道免疫细胞驻留的关键粘附分子。此外，肿瘤诱导的β-肾上腺素能应激也可导致绒毛萎缩和通透性增加，进一步破坏屏障。

3. **T细胞迁移的失控**：正常情况下，MAdCAM-1通过与T细胞表面的α4β7整合素结合，将特定亚群的T细胞（如Tr17）限制在肠道黏膜。当屏障分子（如MAdCAM-1）因菌群失调而下调时，这种限制被解除，导致抑制性T细胞从肠道迁移至肿瘤微环境，从而抑制抗肿瘤免疫。同时，胆汁酸代谢产物（如LCA、TCDCA）还可以通过血液循环直接到达肿瘤部位，通过诱导氧化应激和内质网应激直接抑制CD8+ T细胞的功能。

**挑战**：
1. **定义不一致**：缺乏统一的“健康”与“菌群失调”定义，导致跨研究比较困难。
2. **混杂因素多**：年龄、性别、饮食、药物（尤其是抗生素、PPIs）和合并症强烈影响菌群，难以分离出独立的菌群效应。
3. **因果性不明**：许多关联研究无法确定菌群变化是治疗反应的原因还是结果。
4. **技术异质性**：测序方法、生物信息学流程和样本处理方法的差异导致数据不可比。
5. **干预效果的持久性**：粪菌移植（FMT）等干预措施的效果可能受外部因素（如抗生素）影响而不稳定。

**标准化努力**：
1. **ONCOBIOME倡议**：一个国际多中心合作项目，旨在定义 Gut OncoMicrobiome Signatures (GOMs)，开发诊断工具（如TOPOSCORE），并推动微生物组导向干预（MCIs）的临床应用。它强调标准化宏基因组协议和多组学数据整合。
2. **Seerave Global OncoBiome Atlas**：2025年启动的全球平台，链接微生物组谱、用药记录和免疫治疗结果，用于前瞻性验证微生物组工具（如TOPOSCORE）并在常规肿瘤护理中实施干预。它提供了一个基础设施，以系统追踪微生物组调节药物的真实世界效果。
3. **临床试验**：如IMMUNOLIFE2试验，正在测试FMT联合抗PD-1治疗在抗生素诱导的免疫治疗耐药患者中的疗效，旨在为微生物组恢复提供临床证据。", "conditions": "基于ONCOBIOME项目文档、Seerave Atlas发布声明及IMMUNOLIFE2试验设计；涉及多国合作。", "reference_ids": ["R207", "R236"]}, {"attribution": "Routy et al. (2023); Baruch et al. (2021)", "use_in_review": "提供FMT在临床转化中的初步证据和挑战，说明干预措施的可行性和局限性。", "finding": "多项I/II期临床试验表明，FMT可以恢复对免疫治疗耐药的黑色素瘤患者的敏感性。然而，FMT的效果取决于供体菌株的定植能力、受体的生态韧性以及外部因素（如后续抗生素使用）。长期随访显示，FMT的效果可能持续数周至数月，但复发常见。此外，临床成功并不总是依赖于供体菌株的完全替代，暗示机制可能涉及代谢物传递或免疫调节而非单纯的菌群替换。这些发现突显了需要标准化的供体筛选、给药方案和疗效监测指标。", "conditions": "黑色素瘤患者；FMT联合抗PD-1治疗；随访时间7-65天不等。", "reference_ids": ["R229", "R231", "R232", "R234"]}], "explanation": "当前临床转化面临的主要挑战包括：
1. **标准化缺失**：由于缺乏统一的菌群失调定义和分析流程，不同研究的结果难以直接比较和整合。
2. **个体异质性**：宿主的遗传背景、生活方式和用药史极大地影响了菌群组成，使得识别普适性的生物标志物和干预靶点变得困难。
3. **因果机制复杂**：菌群与治疗反应之间的关系往往是双向的，且受到多种混杂因素的干扰，确立因果关系需要更严谨的前瞻性研究和机制探索。
4. **干预措施的稳定性**：如FMT等干预措施的效果可能不稳定，容易受到患者自身生态系统和外部因素（如抗生素）的影响。

为解决这些问题，正在进行以下标准化努力：
1. **ONCOBIOME倡议**：通过国际合作，建立标准化的宏基因组分析流程，开发经过验证的诊断工具（如TOPOSCORE），并推动GOMs在临床中的应用。
2. **全球数据平台**：Seerave Global OncoBiome Atlas旨在整合全球范围内的微生物组数据、临床信息和用药记录，为大规模前瞻性验证提供支持。
3. **规范化临床试验**：如IMMUNOLIFE2等试验正在严格评估微生物组导向干预（如FMT）在特定患者群体中的疗效和安全性，为未来的临床指南提供证据基础。", "remaining_points": ["TOPOSCORE等数字工具在真实世界临床实践中的接受度和可操作性如何？", "如何优化FMT供体筛选标准以提高定植成功率和疗效一致性？", "长期监测微生物组变化的最佳频率和方法是什么？"]}]

1. **生态拓扑结构**：通过TOPOSCORE等模型，将菌群失调定义为有益功能群（SIG2，如丁酸盐产生菌）的崩溃和致病/促炎群（SIG1，如Enterocloster、Clostridium）的扩张。这种定义捕捉了物种间的拮抗关系和功能冗余的丧失。

limits: 人类癌症患者接受 ICI 治疗的队列研究，报告血清/血浆或肿瘤组织中肌苷或 SCFAs 的绝对浓度值（如μM），并提供与 ORR、PFS 或 OS 的统计关联（HR、OR、p 值），同时通过同位素标记或菌株追踪证实代谢物的微生物来源。

fulfillment_judgment.auxiliary_material: 作者明确指出该研究的局限性在于体外实验使用的 ICA 剂量与体内检测到的浓度存在差异，且目前缺乏人类药代动力学数据（吸收、分布、代谢、排泄），无法确认 ICA 在人体内是否能达到同等有效浓度。研究未涉及人类患者样本，也未报告任何人类临床终点（如 ORR、PFS、OS）与代谢物浓度的统计关联。
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: 需继续检索包含人类队列的研究，重点关注报告了血清/血浆/组织代谢组学数据并与免疫治疗临床结局进行关联分析的文献。搜索关键词应包含“人类”、“代谢物浓度”、“免疫检查点抑制剂”、“临床响应”及特定代谢物名称（如肌苷、SCFAs、色氨酸代谢物）。同时可关注是否有研究采用了同位素示踪技术来确认代谢物来源。
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: 本材料未提供人类血清/血浆或肿瘤组织中肌苷、短链脂肪酸或 ICA 的绝对浓度数值（μM 范围）。未报告任何人类样本中代谢物水平与 ICI 临床响应（ORR、PFS、OS）的统计关联（HR、OR、p 值）。未通过同位素标记或菌株追踪在人类中证实代谢物的微生物来源。
fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: 该研究在小鼠模型中定量了微生物代谢物吲哚 -3-羧酸（ICA）的浓度。作者使用液相色谱 - 质谱（LC-MS）检测了小鼠血清、肿瘤组织和粪便中的 ICA 及犬尿氨酸（Kyn）水平，发现 L. gallinarum 处理组血清和肿瘤组织中 ICA 显著富集，而 Kyn 水平降低。研究证实 ICA 能通过抑制肿瘤 IDO1 表达和竞争性拮抗 T 细胞表面的 AHR 受体，减少调节性 T 细胞（Treg）浸润并增强 CD8+ T 细胞功能，从而在 MC38 和 CT26 同基因小鼠模型及 AOM/DSS 诱导的结直肠癌模型中提高抗 PD-1 疗效。这为“微生物代谢物可调节 ICI 疗效”提供了具体的分子机制证据和临床前定量分析范例。

fulfillment_judgment.auxiliary_material: The study details the isolation and genomic characterization of Parasutterella mc1, showing it is asaccharolytic and relies on amino acids. It reports changes in bile acid profiles (e.g., reduced cholic acid, taurocholic acid) and associated host gene expression (FXR signaling, Cyp7a1) in mice. The experimental design involved environmental exposure of specific-pathogen-free C57BL/6J mice to the bacterial isolate, with microbial community structure assessed via 16S rRNA sequencing and metabolites measured in cecal contents rather than serum or plasma.
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Use this material to support the review's discussion on the mechanistic plausibility of microbiome-derived metabolites (like inosine) modulating host physiology and immunity, citing the observed 74.4-fold change in gut inosine as evidence of microbial control. Clearly distinguish this preclinical mechanistic data from the missing clinical evidence. For the gap resolution, prioritize searching for human cohort studies that combine metabolomics (specifically targeting purines/SCFAs in blood/tissue) with ICI treatment records and survival/response data.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The specific requirement for absolute concentration values (e.g., μM) of inosine or SCFAs in human serum, plasma, or tumor microenvironment samples linked to ICI clinical response (ORR, PFS, OS) remains unaddressed. This study did not involve human participants, immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment, cancer models, or clinical outcome measurements. Additionally, the metabolite data reported are primarily relative fold changes in mouse cecal contents rather than absolute quantifications in systemic circulation, and microbial origin was inferred from colonization status rather than isotope labeling in vivo.
fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: This study provides mechanistic evidence that a specific gut commensal bacterium (Parasutterella) can significantly alter purine metabolite levels, specifically reporting a 74.4-fold decrease in inosine abundance in mouse cecal contents upon colonization. It also confirms succinate production (approximately 2.5 mM in broth culture) by this bacterium. The authors utilized UPLC-FTMS untargeted metabolomics to profile these changes and discussed the potential immunomodulatory roles of inosine and hypoxanthine based on existing literature, suggesting a pathway through which gut microbes might influence host immune status via metabolite modulation.

fulfillment_judgment.auxiliary_material: The study details a machine learning-based feature selection workflow (SVM) to identify metabolite panels for cancer detection. It provides comparative metabolic profiles between TNBC and non-TNBC subtypes, showing higher nucleotide metabolism activity in TNBC. The research includes calibration curve parameters and validation cohort performance metrics (AUC, sensitivity, specificity) for the metabolite panel, which can inform the design of similar metabolomic studies.
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Cite this study to support the feasibility of absolute inosine quantification in human plasma and to illustrate the biological plausibility of inosine modulating immune suppression via the A2AR-Treg axis. Use the mechanistic findings to hypothesize how metabolic environments might influence ICI resistance, but explicitly clarify that the clinical data pertains to chemotherapy rather than immunotherapy and that microbial sourcing was not investigated. Recommend future studies to replicate the quantification method in ICI-treated cohorts with microbial source tracking.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The supplied material does not report statistical associations between metabolite concentrations and Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor (ICI) clinical endpoints such as ORR, PFS, or OS; the clinical validation was performed for neoadjuvant chemotherapy response. Furthermore, the study does not confirm the microbial origin of the measured inosine or uridine through isotope labeling or strain tracking, treating them primarily as host/tumor nucleotide metabolism products. The success criteria requiring ICI outcome linkage and microbial source verification remain unaddressed.
fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: This study established an absolute quantitative assay for plasma inosine and uridine using stable isotope labeled-internal standards (SIL-IS) in 1111 human participants, providing a methodological reference for measuring absolute concentrations (e.g., via HILIC-MRM-MS). It reported that lower plasma inosine levels were statistically associated with better pathological complete response (pCR) to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) patients. Additionally, single-cell RNA sequencing data from tumor tissues revealed a mechanistic link where nucleotide metabolism in tumor cells correlates with regulatory T cell (Treg) activation via the adenosine receptor A2AR, suggesting an immune-suppressive role for inosine-related pathways in the tumor microenvironment.

auxiliary_material: 研究详细描述了厌氧嘌呤降解的生化途径和遗传基础，指出不同菌株（甚至同种不同株，如 E. coli K12 与 MS 200-1）在利用嘌呤作为碳源和能源的能力上存在显著差异。
研究讨论了肠道上皮细胞对嘌呤的高需求（用于核苷酸合成和能量平衡），提示微生物过度消耗嘌呤可能对宿主肠道屏障功能产生负面影响，这为理解微生物代谢物与宿主健康的复杂关系提供了背景。
该研究将 UA 视为一种尿毒症毒素和促炎因子，其在可溶性范围内的升高即可通过 AMPK 介导的炎症通路促进动脉粥样硬化，这为代谢物浓度与炎症性疾病进展的关联提供了机制解释。
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: 在综述中引用该研究作为‘微生物代谢物调控宿主系统性浓度’的机制性证据，特别是展示特定菌群（携带特定基因簇）如何显著改变循环中嘌呤类代谢物（如 UA）的水平。利用其关于饮食（碳源）和微量元素调控微生物代谢活性的发现，讨论宿主环境因素可能如何间接影响微生物代谢谱。明确区分该研究与 ICI 疗效研究的界限，将其作为非脂质/非氨基酸代谢通路（嘌呤代谢）影响宿主炎症状态的典型案例，用以支持‘微生物代谢组复杂性’的论点，但不能直接用于回答关于 ICI 响应预测因子的具体问题。
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: 该材料未涉及免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗背景，未报告任何癌症患者样本中肌苷或短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）的绝对浓度值，也未进行这些代谢物与 ICI 临床响应终点（ORR, PFS, OS）的统计关联分析。此外，虽然研究证实了微生物对嘌呤代谢的贡献，但未在人类样本中使用同位素标记或菌株追踪技术直接证实特定代谢物的微生物来源。
useful_material: 该研究在人类队列（n=998，瑞典人群）中测量了血清尿酸（Uric Acid, UA）的绝对浓度，并发现其与冠状动脉钙化（CAC）评分呈正相关（Spearman rho=0.14, p<0.001），CAC>0 组的 UA 水平显著高于 CAC=0 组。
研究鉴定了能够厌氧降解嘌呤（包括 UA、腺嘌呤、次黄嘌呤）的肠道细菌类群（如 Bacillota, Pseudomonadota, Fusobacteriota），并确定了负责该功能的关键基因簇（包含 dpaL, hydA, ssnA, ygeY, xdhD 等基因）。
在无菌小鼠模型中，定植含有嘌呤降解菌（PDB）的合成菌群显著降低了血浆中的 UA 水平以及盲肠中的多种嘌呤代谢物（如次黄嘌呤、尿囊素），证明了特定微生物代谢功能对宿主系统性代谢物浓度的直接调控作用。
研究揭示了微生物嘌呤代谢受环境因素调控的机制：葡萄糖或果糖的存在会通过分解代谢物阻遏（catabolite repression）抑制 UA 的降解；某些菌株（特别是 Proteobacteria）的 UA 降解能力依赖于微量元素钼（Mo）和硒（Se）的供应。
该研究提供了肌苷（inosine）、黄嘌呤（xanthine）、次黄嘌呤（hypoxanthine）等嘌呤类代谢物在小鼠血浆和盲肠内容物中的相对丰度变化数据（通过质谱检测），并显示这些代谢物与动脉粥样硬化斑块大小相关。

fulfillment_judgment.auxiliary_material: The study population consisted of healthy adults undergoing stem cell mobilization, not cancer patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). The intervention was G-CSF, and the outcome measured was metabolite change relative to treatment status, not clinical tumor response (ORR, PFS, OS). The authors discussed potential immunoregulatory functions of altered metabolites (e.g., tryptophan, branched-chain amino acids) but did not confirm microbial origin through isotope labeling or strain tracking. The text does not specify absolute concentration units (e.g., μM) for the metabolites, relying on relative peak areas.
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Use this material to support the background assertion that metabolites like inosine and fatty acids are detectable and dynamic in human serum under immune-modulating conditions. Highlight the study's finding that inosine levels can shift significantly in response to immune-related interventions. Explicitly note in the review that this study does not satisfy the gap criteria regarding ICI outcomes, absolute quantification, or microbial source confirmation, thereby distinguishing it from the target evidence needed for the planning gap.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The core requirement to link absolute or relative metabolite concentrations (specifically microbial metabolites like inosine or SCFAs) to ICI clinical efficacy endpoints in human cancer patients is not fulfilled. There is no data on ICI treatment response, no absolute concentration values reported in standard units, and no verification of microbial origin for the detected metabolites. The context remains limited to G-CSF-induced changes in healthy donors.
fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: This study examined systemic metabolomic profiles in serum from 15 healthy stem cell donors before and after G-CSF administration using non-targeted metabolomics (UPLC-MS/MS and GC-MS). The authors reported that levels of several nucleotides and nucleotide metabolites, specifically including inosine, guanosine, and adenosine, were significantly decreased after G-CSF treatment. Additionally, the study identified alterations in lipid metabolism, including increased levels of long-chain and polyunsaturated fatty acids, and decreased levels of sphingosine 1-phosphate. Quantification was performed using area-under-the-curve, and statistical significance was assessed via t-tests and Random Forest classification.

fulfillment_judgment.auxiliary_material: The authors explicitly noted limitations regarding the mouse model's fidelity to human dysbiotic states and the need for randomized controlled trials in humans. The study compared prophylactic versus therapeutic timing of probiotic administration, finding prophylactic intervention yielded stronger tumor inhibition. It identified specific bacterial strains (e.g., Lactobacillus rhamnosus, Bifidobacterium animalis) associated with metabolite production.
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Cite this study in the review to illustrate the preclinical mechanistic plausibility of metabolite-mediated microbiome-ICI interactions (specifically SCFAs and α-ketoglutaric acid). Use its quantification methods and correlation analyses as a reference for what human studies should aim to report. Explicitly state that these findings are from murine models and do not fulfill the requirement for human clinical data. Prioritize searching for human cohort studies (e.g., melanoma or RCC metabolomics cohorts) that report baseline serum metabolite levels correlated with survival or response rates.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: This material does not provide absolute concentration values of microbial metabolites in human serum, plasma, or TME tissues. It lacks statistical associations with human clinical ICI response endpoints (ORR, PFS, OS). There is no confirmation of microbial source for the metabolites in human patients via isotope labeling or strain tracking. The gap for human clinical quantification and validation remains open.
fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: This study quantified absolute concentrations of fecal short-chain fatty acids (acetate, propionate, butyrate) and serum metabolites (α-ketoglutaric acid, N-acetyl-L-glutamic acid, pyridoxine) in a mouse colorectal cancer model using LC-MS. It reported statistical correlations between these metabolite levels and tumor volume/survival outcomes under anti-PD-1 therapy. The authors demonstrated a mechanistic pathway where probiotic modulation of gut microbes increased SCFAs, which correlated with increased serum immunomodulatory metabolites and enhanced T cell infiltration in the tumor microenvironment. Causal links were supported by fecal microbiota and supernatant transplantation experiments.

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Use the Table 1 data to list at least 3 trials with their donor sources and health screening exclusions (Section 4.1) to partially meet the first success criterion. fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The supplied text does not provide specific quantitative microbial abundance thresholds (e.g., specific genus % or diversity index values) used as pre-screening inclusion criteria for donors in the listed trials. useful_material: Table 1 summarizes 29 clinical trials investigating FMT with ICIs, specifying donor sources for each (e.g., 'Responders to ICIs', 'Healthy People', 'Healthy People with High-fiber Diets'), trial phase, tumor type, and primary outcomes (ORR, PFS, AEs).

Section 4.1 details general donor screening criteria currently used, including exclusion of individuals with high-risk behaviors, severe obesity, autoimmune diseases, malignancies, and neurological disorders, as well as laboratory screening for pathogens (C. difficile, viruses, antimicrobial-resistant organisms).

Section 2.1 and 2.2 provide specific outcome data for trials with different donor types: NCT03341143 (Donors: ICI Responders) showed 40% clinical benefit; NCT03772899 (Donors: Healthy People) showed 65% ORR; NCT03817125 (SER-401 from donors with favorable signatures) showed lower ORR (25%) than placebo.

Section 3.2 and 4.1 explicitly state that donor selection is critical, FMT from different donors results in markedly different outcomes, and there is currently no uniform standard for donor screening due to disparities in regional regulations and ongoing debate on criteria like age, BMI, and specific microbial thresholds.

Section 4.3 and 2.1.1 identify specific microbial signatures associated with response in certain trials (e.g., elevated Enterococcaceae, Enterococcus, Streptococcus australis in NCT03353402 responders; higher Proteobacteria and Lachnospiraceae in ChiCTR2100046768 responders), though these are often reported as post-hoc findings rather than pre-screening thresholds.

auxiliary_material: Study design: Single-arm phase IIa basket trial (NCT05286294) with 12 recipients and 3 donors.
Clinical outcomes: ORR 0%, median PFS 1.5 months, median OS 10.1 months; one patient achieved clinical benefit (stable disease >6 months) with durable engraftment.
Safety: FMT well tolerated (33% FMT-related AEs, mostly grade 1-2); irAEs occurred in 50% of patients, mostly consistent with prior history.

Biomarker findings: Baseline differentiated T-cell environment associated with improved outcomes; increased CD14+ monocytes and IL-8 associated with poor outcomes; these immune features appeared reflective of host status rather than FMT-induced changes.
Limitations acknowledged by authors: Small sample size, heterogeneity across studies, lack of control group, exploratory nature of immune analyses.
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: ['Use the MITRIC trial as a primary case study to illustrate one specific set of donor screening criteria (ICI responder status + safety screening) and administration protocol.', 'Cite the Discussion section to support the argument that heterogeneity in donor selection (responder vs healthy, single vs multiple) and procedural protocols exists across the field and impacts efficacy consistency.', 'Highlight the finding that durable engraftment correlated with clinical benefit in this study as evidence for the importance of donor-recipient matching, while noting the lack of standardized microbiome thresholds.', "Acknowledge in the review that while this study provides deep detail on one protocol, the '3 trial criteria' requirement necessitates synthesizing data from the referenced external studies (Baruch, Davar, etc.) which are mentioned but not fully detailed here."]
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: ["Specific donor screening criteria (e.g., exact pathogen panels, microbial abundance thresholds, diversity indices) for the other referenced trials (Baruch et al, Davar et al, Kim et al, TACITO) are not detailed in this text, preventing a direct comparison table of at least 3 trials' criteria based solely on this material.", 'No unified definition of donor microbiome characteristics is provided; the text confirms this absence rather than resolving it.', "Evidence linking specific donor microbial features (beyond 'ICI responder' status) to clinical outcomes is limited to engraftment similarity in one patient within this study; broader correlation across trials requires external data."]
useful_material: Provides detailed donor screening criteria for the MITRIC trial: donors must have a cancer diagnosis and >12 months response to ICIs; safety screening includes microbiological analyses of stool, blood, and urine based on international guidelines.
Describes FMT administration protocol: up to five administrations, first two by colonoscopy (100 mL to terminal ileum and cecum), subsequent by enema; no antibiotic pretreatment.

Reports donor-recipient engraftment data: beta diversity analysis showed increased similarity to donors in 8/10 recipients at week 2, but often transient; durable engraftment observed in the single patient with clinical benefit.

Discusses heterogeneity across trials in the Discussion section: notes differences in donor selection (ICI responders vs healthy donors), number of donors (single vs multiple), FMT preparation, route, and schedule as potential reasons for discrepant outcomes compared to Baruch et al, Davar et al, and Kim et al.

Explicitly states that unified criteria for donor selection and microbiome characteristics are not yet established ('questions remain regarding patient and donor selection... generalizability across different studies has proven difficult').

sources.title: Safety and efficacy of fecal microbiota transplantation in solid cancers resistant to immune checkpoint inhibitors: results of the MITRIC trial

fulfillment_judgment.auxiliary_material: The text provides context on the regulatory landscape, noting that FMT is classified differently across countries (e.g., investigational drug in the US/France vs. tissue transplant in Italy/Netherlands), which contributes to protocol heterogeneity. It mentions the concept of 'super donors' selected via clinical predictors (young, lean, vaginal delivery) and microbiome profiles, but cautions that a 'one stool fits all' approach is likely ineffective due to donor-recipient compatibility issues. The review also outlines the risks of FMT, including the transmission of procarcinogenic strains (e.g., pks+ E. coli) and MDR bacteria, emphasizing the need for rigorous long-term safety screening beyond standard infectious disease panels. It describes working protocol variables such as the route of delivery (capsules vs. colonoscopy) and dietary adjuvants (low-fermentable fibers) as factors influencing efficacy.
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Use the cited studies within this review (e.g., Baruch et al. for melanoma, Paramsothy et al. or Haifer et al. for UC) as pointers to locate the original trial protocols for specific numerical thresholds. Extract the general safety screening categories (MDROs, chronic diseases) and the qualitative microbial features (high diversity, specific beneficial taxa) described here to draft a summary of current practices. Explicitly state in the review that while qualitative features are identified, standardized quantitative thresholds for donor selection remain undefined and heterogeneous across the field, citing this study's observation on the inconsistency of alpha diversity as a predictor. Use the discussion on regulatory differences and working protocol variations (antibiotics, dosage) to explain the sources of heterogeneity affecting efficacy consistency.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The supplied material does not list at least three distinct FMT clinical trials with their full, specific inclusion/exclusion criteria tables (e.g., exact numerical thresholds for diversity indices or specific abundance cutoffs for taxa) as requested by the success criteria. While it mentions specific taxa associated with success in melanoma and UC, it does not provide the precise quantitative definitions (e.g., 'Shannon index > X' or 'Faecalibacterium > Y%') used in those trials. Furthermore, the text does not provide a direct comparative analysis quantifying how specific screening heterogeneities statistically impact疗效 consistency (ORR or irAEs) across trials; it mostly reports associations within individual studies or meta-analyses without a unified comparison of screening protocols themselves. The link to irAEs (immune-related adverse events) is not explicitly detailed in terms of donor screening criteria preventing them.
fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: This study (a review by Porcari et al.) identifies specific donor microbiome features associated with clinical success in FMT, which serves as a proxy for the types of criteria used in trials. For Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor (ICI) refractory melanoma, it cites trials where donors were selected based on high alpha diversity and abundance of specific taxa (Ruminococcaceae, Faecalibacterium, Bifidobacterium longum, Akkermansia muciniphila). For Ulcerative Colitis (UC), it notes criteria such as higher microbiome evenness, richness, and specific abundances (Lachnospiraceae, Ruminococci, Akkermansia), while excluding donors with Streptococci. Regarding safety screening, the text details standard exclusion criteria for donors, including chronic GI disorders, systemic autoimmune disorders, cancer, neurological/psychiatric conditions, obesity/metabolic disorders, and recent exposure to antimicrobials, immunosuppressants, or proton pump inhibitors. It also highlights the mandatory screening for Multi-Drug Resistant Organisms (MDROs) and SARS-CoV-2 following FDA alerts. The study discusses the heterogeneity of protocols, noting that factors like antibiotic priming (e.g., vancomycin/neomycin vs. rifaximin), bowel cleansing, number of infusions, and fecal amount (e.g., >30g vs >300g) vary significantly between trials and influence engraftment and outcomes. It explicitly states that while donor alpha diversity predicts engraftment, its correlation with clinical success is inconsistent across different diseases and trials.

auxiliary_material: 概述了 FMT 恢复微生物稳态的机制，解释了为何供体微生物组成对疗效至关重要。
讨论了宿主遗传背景对微生物干预反应的个体差异，暗示供体 - 受体匹配可能影响疗效一致性。
总结了 FMT 在临床应用中主要集中于 CDI，而在癌症（包括 CRC 和免疫治疗）中的应用尚处于探索阶段，解释了为何标准化筛选方案可能尚未成熟。
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: 1. 检索临床试验注册库（如 ClinicalTrials.gov）中涉及 FMT 联合免疫治疗的试验方案（Protocol），提取具体的供体纳入/排除标准。2. 查找专门针对 FMT 供体筛选的系统评价或共识指南，获取通用的病原体筛查清单和微生物组质量标准。3. 寻找分析供体微生物特征与受体 ICI 疗效相关性的原始研究，以建立筛选标准与临床结局的关联证据。
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: 该材料未列出至少 3 项 FMT 临床试验的具体供体筛选标准（如特定菌属丰度阈值、多样性指数、具体的健康筛查清单）；未提供不同试验间供体筛选方案异质性的比较数据；未提供供体筛选特征与临床结局（ORR、irAEs）关联的直接证据。材料确认了统一定义的缺失，但未提供现有的具体实践标准细节。
useful_material: 该研究明确指出目前尚无关于微生物失调的定量定义（'no quantitative definitions regarding microbial dysbiosis are available'），直接回应了 gap 中关于统一供体微生物组特征定义的问题，确认了标准化的缺失。
提及 FDA 安全警报，指出供体粪便中可能携带多重耐药菌（如产 ESBL 大肠杆菌）并导致受体感染，强调了供体筛选中致病菌排除标准（如 MDR 细菌筛查）的必要性。
列举了一项正在进行的 FMT 临床试验（NCT03341143），其供体筛选策略基于临床功能（'FMT from anti-PD1 responders'），提供了一种供体筛选的思路（基于治疗反应者），尽管未提供具体的微生物阈值。
指出 FMT 可能传播致病基因（如肥胖、动脉粥样硬化相关基因），提示供体筛选需考虑长期健康风险而不仅是传染病。

auxiliary_material.content: Recipient baseline total fecal siderophore genes copy number (cutoff 755.88 copies/ng) predicted FMT responsiveness with 94.7% specificity and 72.5% sensitivity.
auxiliary_material.relevance: While this focuses on recipient predictors rather than donor criteria, it illustrates the concept of using specific microbial functional thresholds (gene copy number) to define treatment success, which parallels the gap's inquiry about unified microbiome feature definitions.

auxiliary_material.content: Observation that responders showed increased Faecalibacterium and decreased Enterobacteriaceae post-FMT, while non-responders did not show these shifts.

fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Search for additional FMT clinical trial protocols (especially in oncology/ICI contexts if available, or other UC/CD trials) to extract at least 2 more donor screening criteria sets. fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: This study provides detailed screening criteria for only one single-center cohort (1 out of the required 3 trials). It does not compare heterogeneity across multiple trials or empirically analyze how different donor screening protocols impact efficacy consistency between studies. The link between *donor* screening specifics and clinical outcomes is asserted in the background but not tested within this study's design (donors were consistent across patients).

P0584综述指出，目前缺乏标准化、大规模的多中心纵向研究，作者明确呼吁未来进行大型RCT以验证发现，确认在当前文献中不存在此类已完成的Phase III数据。2. P0578报告了MITRIC试验的结果，这是一项单臂、Phase IIa篮子试验，评估了在ICI治疗进展的晚期癌症患者中使用ICI反应者供体的FMT作为挽救疗法的效果。结果显示该干预措施安全性良好但临床活性有限（客观缓解率ORR为0%），且并非Phase III RCT。3. P0583报告了FMT-LUMINate试验的结果，这是一项多中心、开放标签、Phase 2试验，评估了健康供体FMT联合一线ICI在非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）或黑色素瘤中的效果。虽然显示了较高的ORR（NSCLC为80%，黑色素瘤为75%），但该研究同样不是Phase III RCT，且作者提到其后续将纳入CanBiome2随机试验（NCT06623461），但本文未报告该Phase 3试验的结果。因此，截至这些材料的发表时间，尚无已发表的Phase III RCT结果直接回答该问题。

tool_materials.still_missing: 需要寻找直接在人类肿瘤活检样本或微透析液中量化肌苷浓度的研究，并确认是否有研究将这种局部浓度与肿瘤细胞内的UBA6表达水平进行了统计学关联分析。
tool_materials.usable_content: 现有材料未提供直接测量人类肿瘤组织（TME）内肌苷绝对浓度并与UBA6表达水平进行关联分析的研究证据。P0582明确指出，其研究未在临床队列中验证或测量肌苷，而是依赖UBA6表达作为通路活性的代理指标；该研究仅报告了肾细胞癌患者血浆中的肌苷水平与生存期的关联，且未提供具体的绝对浓度数值。P0075综述中提到的肌苷在肿瘤内的浓度阈值（如100–200 μM）是基于小鼠模型（B16黑色素瘤、CT26结直肠癌等）的实验数据，并非人类肿瘤组织的实测值。P0543同样指出，特定代谢物在TME中的浓度往往是推断而非在所有背景下直接测量的。因此，目前缺乏在人类实体瘤中同时测定局部肌苷浓度并分析其与UBA6表达关系的直接数据。
